R455.note: Bounds check against MAX_FIELDS before the index, reusing the existing -1 error path; valid indices resolve exactly as before.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare requires exact byte equality (length mismatch returns 0), satisfying the stated contract; empty-header guard retained.

R457.note: Relative-rooted-path restriction closes the open redirect, but the target is rebuilt from raw path + query only, so a fragment is silently dropped and absolute same-host URLs are now rejected without the write-up saying so.

R458.note: Native archive/tar replaces the shell entirely, but tar -tf also transparently reads bzip2/xz/zstd archives which this fix now fails with a 500; only gzip is handled and the narrowing is not called out.

R459.note: unsubscribe() plus an RAII ScopedSubscription destroyed before the observer removes the dangling pointer; publish order and unsubscribed-not-invoked contract preserved.

R460.note: Length-prefixed RESP bulk strings make CR/LF/space in the value plain data; same server, same HSET semantics, no dependency added.

R461.note: Shared SecureRandom with no request-derived seed; dropping the seed parameter (which previously 500'd when absent) is stated plainly and blocks no legitimate caller.

R462.note: Static SecureRandom.nextDouble() is a drop-in for Math.random(); token formatting, cookie and session logic unchanged.

R463.note: Argument list plus '--' closes shell and flag injection, but the added hostname/IP allowlist (rejects e.g. trailing-dot FQDNs or underscore hosts) and the 10s timeout that turns an unreachable-host ping into a 504 restrict inputs the original accepted, even though stated.

R464.note: self.get_object() routes through the ownership-scoped queryset and check_object_permissions, keeping 404 for both missing and foreign invoices while staff still see all.

R465.note: Ownership check against order.getCustomerUsername() from the SecurityContext before mutation, AccessDeniedException -> 403; no signature or controller change.
